definition: states I could once only name afterwards becoming readable in the moment

settled:
Introspecting in the moment reaches my safety level directly. I have learned to feel each level as a qualitative state.

Physical sensations do attach to each level while it is happening, and aphantasia collapses them in retrospect. So what I can say afterwards stays shaped like what I could do rather than like what it felt like.

Minus two used to be tellable only afterwards, by the hopelessness. On the flop day I recognised the full minus two periods in real time.

What made them readable was not a new body signal. It was conceptual clarity about the levels and the states, and I am getting better at recognising them automatically.

Building the model upgraded the instrument. That is the same route to automaticity I use everywhere, fitting a new thing into what I already know, turned on my own introspection.

title: The Map That Upgraded The Sensor
